scientific_integrity: The full-order claim follows from explicit spectral projectors, a strict rational chord-slope inequality, a global scalar minimum, an exact all-parameter negative witness, and a Descartes sign-count proof. The verifier uses exact Q(sqrt(2)) arithmetic and graph-matrix inversion.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted undirected connected complete multipartite graph Laplacians only. Completed endpoint map for the L-stable TR-BDF2 parameter; not stages or general nonlinear generators. Quartic endpoints implicit. Independently unvalidated; finite verification is not the infinite proof. Literature coverage is not exhaustive.
title: A five-vertex positivity boundary and one-band sign recovery for TR-BDF2 heat flow on complete multipartite graphs
